intent: A considered no-results state with a drawn document stack, readable query context and actionable suggestions, designed for search and knowledge libraries.

layout.direction: A focused empty-search panel with two offset document sheets, a fine search icon, a 36px Instrument Serif heading, the actual failed phrase and a compact list of alternative topics. Keep neutral graphite surfaces, 14px guidance, clear separators and separate 44px topic/clear actions. Give wrapped topic text at least 8px vertical inner space. Wrap long phrases and labels and keep arrow icons from shrinking.
layout.container: Fill the parent up to 576px; wrap long phrases and topic rows naturally.

motion.entrance: Enter the panel once with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Keep 150ms button press feedback. Query changes update the actual written status without a fabricated result list.
motion.reduced: Subscribe to live prefers-reduced-motion changes, stop and settle the owned entrance immediately and remove press transforms.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: query
props.description: The host search phrase. A blank or whitespace-only query has a written starting state, without claiming an empty phrase failed.

props.name: description
props.default: "Explore a topic, or search with a different phrase."

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Suggested label/query pairs. Stable query and occurrence keys preserve focused topics through reordering, including repeated query values.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Synchronous notification with the chosen query string. The host performs the search and acknowledges query changes; topic actions disable without a handler.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Synchronous request to clear the host search. The clear action disables without a handler.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Preserve EmptySearchProps, SearchSuggestion and the named EmptySearch export. Display query remains owned by the host; callbacks do not optimistically replace it.

Use native topic and clear buttons with Enter/Space activation, 44px targets and visible focus. Send exactly the selected query, or call onClear once. Disable actions that have no corresponding handler.
Keep focus attached to a topic through host reordering, using stable query and occurrence keys rather than list positions. Render repeated supplied queries without duplicate React keys.

Announce the current query or blank-query starting message through a polite status. A refused host proposal retains the actual prior query. Empty and arriving suggestions remain readable without invented results.
Accept long headings, queries and labels, empty arrays and independent instances with separate heading IDs. Wrap text without document overflow; keep the arrow visible.
The component proposes queries and clearing synchronously. The host owns search execution, navigation, loading, persistence and error handling.
